run_inner_loop: run the MAML inner loop to fit modulations to a target image or NeRF scene
compute_loss_fn_image: compute the MSE loss with L2 regularization between a generated image and ground truth
compute_loss_fn_nerf: compute the MSE loss with L2 regularization for NeRF ray rendering against target pixels
create_image_grid_from_batch: create a single grid image by arranging a batch of images into a square layout
log_params_info: log the shapes, count, and byte size of Haiku model parameters to the console
